_sheet: Entities. One row per Escape the Backrooms creature. Model, animations and sounds are the game's; the numbers are this mod's.

_columns.name: str; English name
_columns.material: etb; material the base colour texture is taken from
_columns.anim_idle: etb; animation while it has no target
_columns.sound_chase: ref:sounds; loops while it chases the player
_columns.speed: float; movement speed attribute while chasing (zombie 0.23, a sprinting player outruns about 0.36)
_columns.follow_range: float; blocks at which it notices the player
_columns.respawn_s: float; seconds after dying before it is back at its start
_columns.mesh_scale: float; size of the mesh, from the game's blueprint: mesh component scale x actor scale
_columns.mesh_yaw: float; degrees the mesh is turned inside the actor, from the game's blueprint
_columns.attack_reach: float; blocks from which it can hit
_columns.shade: float; how much of the base colour texture shows as surface colour: low for a metal material, which in the game is dark with reflections

rows.name: Bacteria
rows.verified: in-game autotest 2026-10-08 (PASS) from each of the four starts: drawn with its mesh and animations, chases, reaches and hits the player; moved onto the player's trail when idle. The attack and idle animations were looked at in screenshots only
